text: Document TRN-00 analyzes Synthetic Aperture Radar pipelines for orbital earth observation. Calibrated sensors quantify microwave backscatter across calibrated swaths before computing interferometric phase coherence. Downstream assimilation modules translate those measurements into surface deformation forecasts. State-space estimators update fast weights at step 100 while bounding numerical drift.
